title: Flatness is transitive for modules
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is a flat $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and let $M$ be a flat $B$-module. Then $M$, regarded as an $A$-module through $A\to B$, is a flat $A$-module.
